import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.StringWriter;
import java.math.BigInteger;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

import javax.xml.bind.JAXBContext;
import javax.xml.bind.Marshaller;

import at.gv.egiz.sl.schema.*;
import at.gv.egiz.sl.schema.InfoboxReadParamsAssocArrayType.ReadValue;

/** Bildet BaseSLConnector + SLMarschaller (PDF-AS 4.4.2, jaxb-runtime 2.3.3) nach und schreibt Golden-Dateien. */
public class Golden {
    static JAXBContext ctx;

    static String marshal(Object o) throws Exception {
        Marshaller m = ctx.createMarshaller();
        m.setProperty(Marshaller.JAXB_FORMATTED_OUTPUT, true);
        m.setProperty(Marshaller.JAXB_ENCODING, "UTF-8");
        StringWriter sw = new StringWriter();
        m.marshal(o, sw);
        return sw.toString();
    }

    static void write(File dir, String name, String content) throws Exception {
        try (FileOutputStream fos = new FileOutputStream(new File(dir, name))) {
            fos.write(content.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        }
    }

    static CreateCMSSignatureRequestType cms(boolean base64, byte[] data, long from, long to, Boolean pades) {
        MetaInfoType meta = new MetaInfoType();
        meta.setMimeType("application/pdf");
        Base64OptRefContentType content = new Base64OptRefContentType();
        if (base64) content.setBase64Content(data); else content.setReference("formdata:fileupload");
        CMSDataObjectRequiredMetaType dobj = new CMSDataObjectRequiredMetaType();
        dobj.setMetaInfo(meta);
        dobj.setContent(content);
        ExcludedByteRangeType ex = new ExcludedByteRangeType();
        ex.setFrom(BigInteger.valueOf(from));
        ex.setTo(BigInteger.valueOf(to));
        dobj.setExcludedByteRange(ex);
        CreateCMSSignatureRequestType req = new CreateCMSSignatureRequestType();
        req.setKeyboxIdentifier("SecureSignatureKeypair");
        req.setDataObject(dobj);
        req.setStructure("detached");
        if (pades != null) req.setPAdESFlag(pades);
        return req;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        File dir = new File(args[0]);
        dir.mkdirs();
        ctx = JAXBContext.newInstance("at.gv.egiz.sl.schema");
        ObjectFactory of = new ObjectFactory();

        InfoboxReadRequestType ir = new InfoboxReadRequestType();
        ir.setInfoboxIdentifier("Certificates");
        InfoboxReadParamsAssocArrayType rd = new InfoboxReadParamsAssocArrayType();
        ReadValue rv = new ReadValue();
        rv.setKey("SecureSignatureKeypair");
        rd.setReadValue(rv);
        ir.setAssocArrayParameters(rd);
        write(dir, "infobox-read-request.xml", marshal(of.createInfoboxReadRequest(ir)));

        write(dir, "create-cms-upload.xml", marshal(of.createCreateCMSSignatureRequest(cms(false, null, 1234L, 5678L, null))));
        byte[] data = "%PDF-1.7\n\u0000\u0000\u0000 ende\n".getBytes(StandardCharsets.ISO_8859_1);
        write(dir, "create-cms-base64.xml", marshal(of.createCreateCMSSignatureRequest(cms(true, data, 10L, 12L, null))));
        write(dir, "create-cms-upload-pades.xml", marshal(of.createCreateCMSSignatureRequest(cms(false, null, 4294967296L, 4294975487L, Boolean.TRUE))));
        write(dir, "null-operation-request-jaxb.xml", marshal(of.createNullOperationRequest(new NullOperationRequestType())));
    }
}
